decision.full_conv_cast_stable_silu_one_kernel: feasible only after an explicit mixed-math implementation; not a safe matcher-only change
decision.smallest_actionable_step: Fuse the private F32-to-BF16 Cast and ordinary BF16 stable SiLU in the existing strict unary TU; leave the current convolution kernel and its F32 output unchanged.

facts: Concatenated BF16 samples also feed the published next-history Copy; this source need not be private.
CausalConv has F32 public inputs/output, then an explicit BF16 Cast and ordinary Unary SiLU (lines364-366).
This is a current consumer witness, not a model name or dimensions admission rule.

important_actual_provider: The 18 ordinary BF16 activations actually use hyle::compute::cuda_native::sglang_vendor::act_kernel<__nv_bfloat16,ActivationKind0,false>.
The other 18 unary_gated_op_kernel<&op_hyle_stable_silu,float,true> instances are not evidence that the convolution activation already uses ggml strict unary.
Source roles plus symbol counts establish a candidate; no new graph-node mapping or performance measurement was run.

facts: The input-load batch explicitly deferred output/SiLU fusion.
It preserved F32 convolution MAC and output under the original fast-math TU, followed by the original BF16 Cast and stable activation.

convolution.contract: Float samples/weights/shared window; ascending original j-order sumf += x*w, followed by sumf += b, F32 output. BF16 source is widened exactly at load.
convolution.compiler_domain: -use_fast_math -extended-lambda. Existing native-inspection/conclusions.json records FFMA.FTZ and final FADD.FTZ, not just an algebraic float-dot claim.

cast_and_activation.recipe: q=BF16_RNE(conv_f32); x=exact_F32(q); if negative infinity return +0; else e=expf(-fabsf(x)), s=(x>=0 ? 1/(1+e) : e/(1+e)), y=x*s; out=BF16_RNE(y).
cast_and_activation.actual_provider_note: SGLang ordinary unary uses apply_unary_activation_f32, not its separately defined packed apply_activation_f32. Its SiLU specialization has the same written stable expression as the ggml strict helper; this review does not prove the cached objects are bit-equivalent for every exceptional input.
cast_and_activation.compiler_evidence: src/compute_ggml_runtime/CMakeLists.txt:272 removes -use_fast_math only for unary.cu; actual unary-identity.json has no -use_fast_math. src/compute_provider_cuda/CMakeLists.txt adds no fast-math flag for sglang_kernel.cu. The precise original cached SGLang command/object was not independently reconstructed in this read-only review.

incompatible_existing_shortcut.reason: Legacy conv fused SiLU computes x/(1+expf(-x)) in fast math with F32 destination. It neither rounds the conv result to BF16 first nor implements the ordinary stable tails/negative-infinity contract. Current main intentionally rejects marked stable SiLU from this old fuser.

bounded_exact_epilogue.location: existing strict unary.cu and its private declaration/matcher; no public operation or executor
bounded_exact_epilogue.kernel: Load original F32 conv result; explicit __float2bfloat16_rn; exact __bfloat162float; reuse op_hyle_stable_silu; explicit BF16 RNE store. Keep the intermediate conversion observable to the compiler as needed, as in existing explicit-RoPE conversion boundaries.
bounded_exact_epilogue.existing_template_limit: .scratch/architecture-refactor-2026-10-18/cuda-fusion-precision/native-source/src/ggml-cuda/unary.cu:142 uses the same T for source and destination; a small private mixed-input epilogue adapter is needed, not a false BF16 pointer alias.
cold_pattern: Exact Cast(F32->BF16) output consumed only by the exact ordinary stable SiLU, same logical shape and supported dense native layout.
Keep original dtype and public result descriptors; accept the actual stable marker, never infer this from a function enum alone.

Reuse generic ordinary-region rank/cost and exact whole accepted reservation. Native CPY has a self-reference: preserve the existing private CPY use-count convention, published readers and VIEW/OP_NONE aliases.
A published/extra-read BF16 Cast output, intervening real operation/View alias/control edge, mismatched shape/layout or unsupported provider contract keeps the original chain.
F32 conv escape/publication does not by itself forbid Cast+SiLU fusion because this smaller step still materializes F32 conv. Full Conv fusion must decline when that F32 value escapes.
region_notes: src/graph_provider_ggml_cuda/ggml_cuda_region.cc:527 provides accepted whole-suffix reservation; lines583-612 currently reserve only sample widening+Conv.

A Cast+SiLU pair can take the F32 convolution as an external frontier. If it combines with the existing sample-Cast+Conv proposal, submit one coherent candidate; do not let overlapping pairs steal nodes.
src/compute_provider_ggml_cuda/tensor_program.cc:211 only folds the exact immediately inverse zero-offset reshape. Do not silently peel arbitrary View/CPY chains to force a native pattern.
bounded_exact_epilogue.binding_and_lifetime: At encode use real owners/device/capacity/alignment/overflow checks and require F32 source span disjoint from BF16 output under current restrict promises. Preserve all real external read dependencies; no alias-policy expansion or shadow payload.
validation_needed: Small exact oracle must compare actual current SGLang unary and ggml strict epilogue on identical BF16 rounded inputs, including signed zero/subnormals/finite tails/Inf/NaN. Do not assume source-expression equality is compiled equivalence.
Cast output publication, actual extra reader/View/control, F32 escape, padded/alias negative controls, rebinding/two invocations/held output.
One physical trace must establish actual matches, then paired timing if the implementation is otherwise correct. No launch-count speed assertion.

full_single_kernel_later.possible_shape: Share the existing short/long conv template with a private epilogue/math policy rather than duplicate the convolution algorithm. Instantiate the strict stable-output variant in the strict TU, with the original j-order MAC and bias explicitly preserving the original RN+FTZ contracted operations, then both BF16 RNE boundaries and the exact stable helper.
full_single_kernel_later.hard_requirement: Moving original source arithmetic to strict compilation changes the compiler domain; inserting stable exp/div into the existing fast-math TU also changes the compiler domain. Either is insufficient without explicit math and compiled-object checks.
full_single_kernel_later.existing_precedent: .scratch/architecture-refactor-2026-10-18/cuda-fusion-precision/native-source/src/ggml-cuda/unary.cu:908 uses explicit RN+FTZ PTX to preserve a fast-math primitive within the strict TU. This is a design precedent, not a completed conv proof.
eligibility: All eliminated F32 Conv and BF16 Cast values must be private with exact data/control readers and no escaping alias/history/published use.
Keep real BF16 sample/history readers and F32 weight/bias identities. Preserve existing K/stride/grid/owner/device restrictions and long-tile load guard.
Private native matcher may target BF16 final destination only after its wrapper has truthful mixed dtype metadata and range checks; current conv wrapper explicitly requires F32 output.
Coordinate full candidate with current private input widening reservation; do not reintroduce the earlier disconnected-region zero-hit failure.
unconfirmed: Exact fused FMA/subnormal/NaN operand and final bias signed-zero behavior under a new explicit-math implementation has not been compiled or tested.
No claim that newly proposed full fusion would be faster. Register pressure, strict exp cost, changed memory access and prefill/decode tradeoffs remain empirical.
full_single_kernel_later.not_recommended: A cross-TU strict device call requiring new RDC/device-link build machinery is disproportionate for this batch and is not the current cached closure.

scope_limits: No product change, compilation, GPU/profile run, new precision mode or model whitelist.
This is a next-step design review; original Conv/source/compiler evidence remains in conv-typed-load.zip.
18 candidate pairs are bounded by the current consumer; generic admission must be based on actual graph/dtype/layout/contract rather than the number18.
